# AI UGC ad generator for Claude Code — open-source Arcads alternative

**An AI creator holds your real product and talks to a phone camera; face, voice and label stay locked across shots.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_78267bc8ba20.webp" alt="An AI creator in a bright bathroom holds a white serum bottle beside her face and talks to a phone camera." width="480"></p>

Open-source alternative to Arcads: AI UGC ads with an AI actor holding your real product. Casts a creator whose age matches the claim in the room where the problem happens, writes a phone-real script (a yapper, unboxing, street interview or in-car take) with every line in the prompt, locks the face, the voice and the product label across shots, prompts camera flaws and breaths so it doesn't look waxy, generates on Seedance 2.5, Kling 4 or Creatify through varg, and labels it. It never puts a first-person testimonial or result in an AI mouth (FTC rule) and never targets TikTok Shop presenters (AI voices banned there). Use when someone wants AI UGC ads, an AI creator or actor talking about their product, Arcads/Creatify/MakeUGC-style ads, or UGC without hiring creators. NOT for TikTok Shop affiliate videos (use tiktok-shop-video), product-only shots with no person (use product-photo-to-video), or the same characters across a multi-scene story (use varg-consistent-characters).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill ai-ugc-ad-video                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills ai-ugc-ad-video --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

|---|---|

| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |

| Uses | varg API, Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Creatify, GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana 2.1, ElevenLabs v4, Sync v3 |

- "Make a 20-second UGC ad for my serum from ./serum.jpg, a woman in her 50s in her bathroom, 9:16"
- "Create an in-car yapper ad for our sleep gummies with a 35-year-old dad, 30 seconds, for Meta"
- "I want three street-interview style UGC clips for my knee sleeve, label readable in every shot"
